intermediate.name: Côte de Béguey
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (4) Côte de Béguey (137.3 km)

story: From the start, Baptiste Veistroffer and Jakub Otruba escaped. Alpecin-Premier Tech and Soudal-Quick-Step controlled the race, maintaining a maximum gap of 1:40. The attackers were caught, leading to an inevitable sprint. Tim Merlier sprinted to victory, a day after his lead-out man Bert Van Lerberghe abandoned.
